t: This robust freestanding shelving unit provides dependable storage for various environments. Ideal for organising tools, equipment, and household supplies in a workshop, shed, or garage, it offers a practical solution for trade professionals and DIY enthusiasts. The unit features a durable powder-coated steel frame and 5 adjustable MDF shelves, each capable of supporting up to 100kg. With overall dimensions of 1800mm high, 1200mm wide, and 400mm deep, this versatile metal shelving system helps maintain an organised and efficient workspace.
b: Quick & Easy Assembly, No Hardware Needed
Powder-Coated Steel Frame for Enhanced Durability
Easy Cleaning with Dry or Damp Cloth
